Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This time expression is redundant because both parts refer to “the time of ancient times.” [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，The noun for a person whose job is treating patients is 医生; 医 alone does not fit naturally here. [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：一看到，The sentence means that he sees someone, so the verb needs the resultative complement 到 rather than only the action of looking. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，别人 refers to other people as a group; 别的 is used to distinguish a different item or type. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人：病人，什么病人 asks which type of patient, but this sentence makes a general claim about patients who eat the plant. [rule: word_choice]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，Plants need a suitable measure word such as 株 rather than the general measure word 个. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，Use 这种植物 to refer back clearly to the plant mentioned in the previous sentence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他看到：看到，After 神农 has remained the subject throughout the same sentence, Chinese normally uses zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 病人吃都会觉得：病人吃了都会觉得，The eating must be completed before the patients feel better, so use 了 for the completed action in this conditional situation. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去：神农走了三个月，Put the duration after the verb and use 了 to show that the three-month journey was completed. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 看到：看到了，The sentence narrates a completed moment of seeing the plant, so add 了 after the resultative complement. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代和的时候都表示时间，按教师规则搭配重复。
当医生才是指从事行医职业的自然说法。
这里表示“看见”病人，看到可以正确表达这个意思。
这里应是神农想帮助病人，别人仍表示“其他人”，没有改正所指对象。
什么病人和都连用可以表示“任何病人”，本身不一定是在问病人类型。
一株植物更具体自然，但一个植物并非必然错误。
用这种植物能明确指回前面听说的那一种植物。
神农刚在前面出现，使用他作为近距离指称是可以的，并非必须删去。
吃了表示先完成吃这一动作，再产生觉得身体更好的结果。
走了三个月正确表达已经完成了三个月的步行。
看到了能标明故事中看见植物这一完成的事件。
